newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo insolvencies fall in Oct, total debt up - IZIT.
newsitem.headline: Yugo insolvencies fall in Oct, total debt up - IZIT.

text.p: Total number of insolvent Yugoslav firms fell in October to 21,126 from 21,486 a month ago, while their matured but unpaid liabilities were almost 14 percent up, the Institute for Market Research said on Thursday.

IZIT economists attributed the fall to seasonal rise in industrial production, greater activity linked to big barter deals with China and Russia and lower fiscal burden as a result of reduction in taxes from early October.
According to the IZIT institute survey, big companies accounted for the major part of the decline in total number of insolvencies.
Total value of matured but unpaid liabilities grew by 13.9 percent to 5.071 billion dinars ($1 billion), according to the institute. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
